learning_outcomes.text: Students will be able to use the mathematics, basic science, and engineering knowledge previously learned in chemical engineering education to perform catalytic reactor calculations.
Students will have theoretical knowledge about catalysts, homogeneous and heterogeneous catalysis, and their mechanisms.
Students will learn about the structure, properties, characterization, and regeneration of catalysts, and the catalysts used in industrial catalytic processes.
Students will be able to analyze general catalytic mechanisms and catalytic deactivation kinetics.
Students will gain knowledge about the environmental and safety impacts of catalytic processes and contemporary issues.

syllabus_topics: Catalysts Used in Industrial Catalytic Processes
Fundamentals of Heterogeneous Catalysis: Catalytic Reaction Steps in Heterogeneous Catalysis; Kinetics and Mechanism of Heterogeneously Catalyzed Reactions
Catalytic Reactors: Two-Phase Reactors; Three-Phase Reactors
